source.title: Armagh Guardian, 14 April 1899, p. 2 ("Armagh District Elections [Two for each Division]"); labels from the Northern Whig, 15 April 1899, p. 6 (Armagh union: elected and not elected, with party labels)
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name read from the two page images; returned unopposed, no poll

note: First election of the rural district council, polled 6 April 1899 with the county council and the boards of guardians; each district electoral division returned two councillors, who were also the guardians for the division. The Armagh city wards and Keady Urban elected guardians only and are not part of the rural district. Returned unopposed. Printed "Lisnadell" in the Northern Whig.
